description: A polyphonic CV remapper: set the range the incoming voltage covers and the range it should come out in, and it rescales and limits every channel between the two.

params.text: Sets the top of the range the input is expected to cover, -10V to +10V; it cannot be taken below the input LOW knob.
Sets the bottom of the range the input is expected to cover, -10V to +10V; it cannot be taken above the input HIGH knob.
Sets the voltage the top of the input range comes out at, -10V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the bottom of the input range comes out at, -10V to +10V.

inputs.text: The CV to remap, up to 16 channels; anything outside the input range is clamped to it first.

outputs.text: The remapped CV, with the same number of channels as the input and 0 channels while nothing is patched in.

notes: Setting the output HIGH below the output LOW inverts the mapping, which is the same thing the menu's invert item does.
A MOREc8or placed immediately to the right adds CV control of the output range, along with remote inverting and linking; a lamp in each module's name lights when they are joined.
menu: Quick Set Input Range...: 0V to 10V, 0V to 5V, -5V to 5V, -10V to 10V — sets the two input range knobs to a common pair of values.
Quick Set Output Range...: 0V to 10V, 0V to 5V, -5V to 5V, -10V to 10V, 1 Octave @ 1V, 1 Octave @ 2V, 2 Octaves @ 1V, 2 Octaves @ 2V — sets the two output range knobs.
Invert Output — swaps the two output range values, so the mapping runs the other way.
Output Snapping...: None, Octaves, Semitones — rounds the output range knobs and the output voltage to whole volts or to twelfths of a volt.
Add Half-Semitone Offset — adds half a semitone to the snapped output, which stops some 1V per octave modules flickering between two notes; it is inside the Output Snapping submenu.
